title: R.K. Traders sells a machine
body: R.K. Traders purchased a machine on April 01, 2022 for Rs 2,40,000 and spent Rs 10,000 on its installation. The firm charges depreciation at 10% per annum on the original cost under the straight line method and maintains a Provision for Depreciation Account. Its books are closed on March 31 every year. On April 01, 2025, after three full years of use, the machine was sold for Rs 1,60,000 in cash. No other machine was purchased or sold during this period.
